name: Default PPO (humanoid-gym)
tagline: Stock humanoid-gym PPO actor-critic: 3x256 ELU MLP per branch, fixed-LR clipped surrogate with GAE(λ=0.95) and clipped value loss.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman et al. 2017 (PPO) as packaged in humanoid-gym (Han et al. 2024). Stock actor-critic + clipped surrogate; the reference Isaac-Gym→MuJoCo locomotion baseline.

name: PPO + Adaptive KL LR
tagline: Same architecture as default PPO but with adaptive learning rate: shrink/expand LR by 1.5× when measured KL exceeds target_kl·1.5 or falls below target_kl/1.5.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman et al. 2017 / rl_games adaptive-KL recipe. Replaces the fixed-LR PPO baseline with KL-driven LR adaptation; canonical robust-locomotion technique.

name: PPO + LayerNorm MLP
tagline: PPO actor-critic enhanced with LayerNorm after every hidden Linear (and pyramidal hidden sizes [512,256,128]) for sim2sim robustness.
diff_from_baseline: Architectural sim2real tweak: LayerNorm-MLP actor-critic; widely cited as improving distribution-shift robustness for Isaac-Gym→MuJoCo transfer (e.g., He et al. 2024 Humanoid PPO recipes).
